messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off Lotus AI onboarding — quick sync to align stakeholders and success criteria. Proposed kickoff Wed 4/14 10am PT. @olivia_pm @dan_se @sasha_onboard

olivia_pm: Works for PM side. We'll need data ingest details, expected product flows, and the 30d scope.

dan_se: I'll own integrations + runtime checks. Need sample traffic profile and expected QPS. Also confirm whether they plan to use Dedicated or Hosted.

sasha_onboard: I can run enablement. Proposing two 60-min workshops: 1) infra & auth + sample integration 2) prompts & evaluation. Record both and publish labs.

maria_cs: Draft success criteria (please comment):
1) devs can call Redwood API w/ auth and run a sample generate flow end-to-end
2) baseline perf: p50 <200ms for typical gen path, p95 <700ms (hosted) or matching Dedicated SLOs
3) demo flow with 3 intents live in staging within 30 days
4) feedback survey avg >=4/5 from Lotus devs after enablement sessions

jordan_successlead: Note renewal risk — contract renews M11. We should surface product gaps by week 6 and run a health checkpoint at week 8. Capture adoption signals early.

maria_cs: Top risks: VPC routing for Private deployments, dataset PII concerns, model-quality regressions, delay in sample data. Prep checklist:
- anonymized sample dataset
- network diagram (staging + prod)
- expected token volumes and concurrency
- list of must-have intents and failure cases

dan_se: Can Lotus provide a staging endpoint and sample logs? Also need contact for infra/network (for routing). cc @sam_customer

sam_customer: Hi all — Sam from Lotus here. We can provide anonymized logs and a staging endpoint by next Tue. Infra lead is Priya (priya@lotus.ai). I'll intro her after kickoff.

maria_cs: Great, thx Sam. I'll send calendar invite. Agenda draft: 1) intros 2) scope & success criteria 3) tech checklist & ownership 4) enablement plan 5) sample prompts and evals 6) next steps + owners.

sasha_onboard: For enablement, prefer short hands-on labs + a 5-question feedback survey after each session. We'll capture improvement items in the tracking doc.

olivia_pm: We'll also bring a prompt eval set — can Lotus share 20 representative prompts and target outputs? That will speed model selection and surfacing tradeoffs.

dan_se: Action: I'll spin up a staging test harness for the sample traffic and share a quick runbook (auth, endpoints, expected outputs).

maria_cs: Can someone volunteer to own the tracking doc (milestones, owners, risks)?
jordan_successlead: I'll own the tracking doc for the first 30 days and hand over to CSM ops after ramp.

maria_cs: Thanks. Meeting invite sent for Wed 4/14 10am PT. If blockers pop up, flag in this thread. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: Lotus AI Onboarding Kickoff — Wed Apr 14 10:00 PT

sam_customer: Thanks everyone — excited to get started. We'll prep the sample prompts & staging creds.

maria_cs: One more ask — decision on model variant (and quantization) by day 10 to avoid rollback risk and rework.

olivia_pm: Noted. We'll prepare a short tradeoff doc (latency vs quality vs cost) to present during kickoff.

dan_se: Also recommend a quick perf smoke test after initial integration — helps catch infra/kv-cache issues early.

sasha_onboard: We'll publish session recordings and the hands-on lab in the shared folder; include the feedback survey link there.

maria_cs: Follow-ups I'll create: shared tracking doc (Sheet), #lotus-onboard Slack channel, and add owners to calendar invite. Posting tracking doc link in #customer-success after kickoff.

sam_customer: Priya intro incoming. Thanks again.

maria_cs: Great sync. See you all Wed.
